question: Article 368 of the Indian constitution is related to:

options.text: election to the post of president

solution:
The correct answer is __**amendment of the constitution**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Article 368** of the Indian Constitution deals with the **amendment of the Constitution**.
 
• It provides the procedure for both **simple and complex amendments** depending on the nature of the change required.
 
• Amendments can be initiated only by the introduction of a Bill in either House of Parliament and must be passed by a specified majority.
 
• Some amendments require ratification by at least half of the State Legislatures in addition to being passed by both Houses of Parliament.
 
• This Article ensures that the Constitution can be **adapted to changing needs** and circumstances while maintaining its core principles.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• The process for amending the Constitution is designed to be **rigorous** to prevent hasty or ill-considered changes.
 
• Article 368 has been used to make several significant amendments, including the addition of new fundamental rights and the restructuring of the nation's federal framework.
 
• The most notable amendments include the **42nd Amendment** (1976), which is often referred to as the "Mini-Constitution" due to its wide-ranging impact.
 
• Other important amendments include the **73rd and 74th Amendments**, which established a framework for local self-governance in rural and urban areas respectively.
 
• Despite its flexibility, Article 368 maintains the basic structure doctrine as propounded by the Supreme Court, ensuring that the fundamental framework of the Constitution remains intact.
